original_target.title: Arbitrarily large integer-distance sets in general position

scope_comparison: The diameter-dependent quantitative Erdos–Anning theorem does not bound cardinality independently of diameter. Arbitrary finite general-position configurations differ from infinite configurations or the integer-distance graph chromatic number. The public candidate text certifies at least seven points and expressly has no >=8 result.
